title: Finite Source-Weighted Kernels: Strict Peripheral Separation and an Explicit Shrinking-Gap Family
abstract: For finite source-weighted hypercube kernels A=diag(w)K with strictly positive weights, symmetric similarity combines with an elementary real peripheral-separation proof to give full-spectrum strict separation and algebraic simplicity of the Perron eigenvalue. At each finite size the relative gap is positive. We also construct explicit positive, globally size-dependent two-corner source weights at every fixed positive beta for which the relative gap is asymptotic to 2exp(-2beta L). A self-contained variational proof supplies two-sided finite estimates; exact finite rational diagnostics are supporting examples only. This corrects an unsupported historical numerical table and specifies the scope of historical formal declarations without claiming a new formal replay. Priority of the particular family is unestablished. The construction does not describe fixed local Ising interactions, a continuum limit or a physical Yang-Mills mass gap.
